decisions.reason: The cleaning soap builds directly on the firm's surface-treatment know-how and fits its care range. Dropping the oiled-floor care line (C) has likely concentrated care demand on the remaining products, which makes A's continued role easy to judge and cheap to maintain.
The maintenance oil line rests on the firm's own surface-treatment R&D and supports aftersales ties with installers and homeowners. It is a natural successor to the withdrawn care product C.
The moisture-protection underlay is a system accessory that the firm's technical installation guidance can interpret and refine. This keeps its absorptive fit with the core flooring offer high.

Foam underlay lies furthest from the wood-processing core and the firm has limited in-house knowledge to improve it. Still, it is a low-cost, partner-sourced system component that rounds out the accessory range.
The oak parquet line is at the heart of the firm's wood-processing expertise and production base. It gives the firm the strongest capacity to learn from results and develop the line further.
